title: Evidence viewer
responsibility: Shows full-size screenshots with filtered navigation, viewport switching and before/after comparison.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.items
inputs.description: Required full screenshot evidence list, used to find comparison partners and available screen sizes. Partners match comparison identity and viewport with before/after phases.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.navigableItems
inputs.description: Required ordered subset for previous/next and arrow-key navigation. Empty prevents movement.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.selected
inputs.description: Required selected screenshot or null. Non-null opens the modal; null closes it through the modal open prop.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.assetBase
inputs.description: Required prefix concatenated with image files for zoom and download links.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.onclose
inputs.description: Required close callback; closing also resets view to after.

inputs.name: EvidenceViewer.onselect
inputs.description: Required callback receiving a navigated item. Viewport switches pass true as the second argument so the host can update filters; ordinary previous/next omit it.

outputs.name: EvidenceViewer
outputs.description: Screenshot lightbox initially showing after, with before/compare choices when a partner exists. Previous/next wraps through the navigable subset and resets to after. Viewport switching prefers the same comparison, then category/title, category, then first candidate. Displays provenance, captions, missing notes and image links. Changing image/view recreates zoom state.
